subject: Life Skills
title: Video Call Presence
description: A quick, practical guide to Video Call Presence.

hook.text: Stanford research coined 'Zoom fatigue' — video calls drain more energy than in-person meetings.

buildup.text: Staring at your own face triggers constant self-evaluation. That mental load doesn't exist in person.

discovery.text: Looking at the camera, not the screen, creates the illusion of eye contact for the other person.

twist.text: Hiding your self-view reduces fatigue significantly. You stop managing your appearance unconsciously.

climax.text: Mute when not speaking, use gallery view, and take audio-only breaks when cameras aren't needed.

punchline.text: Good presence means less performance, more focus.
